answer: Reputation-decayed identity slots: each new identity must deposit collateral into a vault that unlocks only after sustained honest activity. An attacker spinning up N identities pays N times the deposit plus a decay penalty on each abandoned slot. Every duplicate attempt also triggers a rate-limited whisper channel that alerts existing peers, raising scrutiny costs. A sonnet-length activity proof (fixed-length behavioral sample) must be submitted per slot, so mass fabrication incurs compute and review overhead scaling linearly with N.
